inputs.text: A high-energy cinematic chase through a rain-soaked neon market at night: a red motorcycle carrying a courier races between crowded stalls while a translucent holographic drone pursues overhead. The camera starts low behind the motorcycle, rapidly tracks sideways around it, whip-pans through a narrow gap, then cranes upward into a fast three-quarter orbit and pushes toward the courier's face; strong parallax from umbrellas and hanging signs, splashing puddles, drifting steam, bright reflections, continuous motion, sharp subject detail, coherent anatomy, no text. Layered audio: roaring engine, rain, tires cutting through puddles, distant crowd, and a rising electronic pulse.
